g.text: Restaurant, staff and Happy Hour (entity, stage-3)
+takeOrder(customer : Customer, menu : Menu, happyHour : HappyHour) : Order
Restaurant owns its Tables, staff, HappyHour and every
Customer; none of them exists outside a Restaurant.
The "one task per turn" rule lives in Staff
(ensureAvailable / markActed), so every role gets it.
A rejected choice never calls markActed().
